question: Do Pomerium and Tailcat (awesome-tunneling overlay entries 45 and 5) need egress records?
why: fr search and a record url search found no egress record for either name; they sit outside this unit's slice (overlay entries 28 to 36). Pomerium is an identity-aware access proxy whose reverse-tunneling mode takes SSH -R; Tailcat is a netcat over the Tailscale data plane. The registry row still says 44 overlay entries, while the README lists 45.
